cursor.next(); }\n  seq.remove(b);\n  assert.equal(seq.tombstones, 1);\n  assert.deepEqual(first.next(), { done: false, id: c, value: 'c' });\n  assert.equal(seq.tombstones, 1);\n  last.close();\n  assert.equal(seq.tombstones, 0);\n  assert.deepEqual(events.filter((event) => event.type === 'unlink').map((event) => event.id), [b]);\n  say(`共享墓碑由最后的保留者释放：${b}；unlink 计数 ${events.filter((event) => event.type === 'unlink').length}`);\n  first.close();\n} else if (kind === 'model') {\n  const actualEvents = [];\n  const actual = new Sequence({ onEvent: (event) => actualEvents.push(event) });\n  const model = new Model();\n  const pair = (operation) => {\n    const realResult = operation(actual);\n    const modelResult = operation(model);\n    assert.deepEqual(realResult, modelResult);\n    assert.deepEqual(actualEvents, model.events);\n    assert.deepEqual(actual.ids(), model.ids());\n    assert.equal(actual.tombstones, model.tombstones);\n  };\n  let b;\n  let actualCursor;\n  let modelCursor;\n  pair((list) => list.append('a'));\n  pair((list) => { b = list.append('b'); return b; });\n  pair((list) => list.append('c'));\n  actualCursor = actual.cursor();\n  modelCursor = model.cursor();\n  assert.deepEqual(actualEvents, model.events);\n  pair((list) => list === actual ? actualCursor.next() : modelCursor.next());\n  pair((list) => list === actual ? actualCursor.next() : modelCursor.next());\n  pair((list) => list.remove(b));\n  pair((list) => list === actual ? actualCursor.next() : modelCursor.next());\n  pair((list) => list === actual ? actualCursor.close() : modelCursor.close());\n  const types = actualEvents.map((event) => event.type);\n  assert(types.includes('unlink'));\n  say(`墓碑链表模型逐操作一致：${types.join(' → ')}`);\n} else {\n  throw new Error(`unknown probe: ${kind}`);\n}\n"

B 探针完整输入文件 artifact-copy/README.md以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："# stable-id-sequence\n\n稳定 ID 游标序列库（TypeScript），语义契约：\n\n- **稳定 ID 句柄**：元素句柄 = `{ id, gen }`（槽位 ID + 代际）。\n- **墓碑删除**：`delete` 是逻辑删除；只要仍有游标保留该记录，记录留在链表中，\n  因此**删除当前项后 `next()` 到达原后继**。\n- **游标遍历**：游标锚定“当前记录”。**插入到锚点之前（含锚点处）不会被重访；\n  插入到锚点之后会被后续 `next()` 访问**。\n- **代际复用**：墓碑在保留计数归零时被摘除并回收槽位；**槽位再用时代际 +1**，\n  旧代际句柄一律失效（`get` 返回 `undefined`，其余操作抛 `RangeError`）。\n- **游标关闭**：`close()` 释放保留的记录，可能触发延迟回收。\n- **事件日志**：`insert / delete / recycle / cursor-open / cursor-close`\n  追加到 `store.events`，可与墓碑链表模型（`tests/model.ts`）逐条核验。\n\n## 使用\n\n```ts\nimport { SequenceStore } from \"./src/sequence.ts\";\n\nconst s = new SequenceStore<string>();\nconst ha = s.append(\"a\");\ns.append(\"b\");\nconst cur = s.openCursor();\nconst first = cur.next()!;   // a\ns.delete(first.handle);      // 删除当前项\ncur.next();                  // => b（原后继）\ncur.close();                 // 释放保留记录\n```\n\n## 测试\n\n```sh\nnpm test   # tsc 类型检查 + 编译 + node:test（含与模型的随机一致性核验）\n```\n"

B 探针完整输入文件 artifact-copy/dist/src/sequence.js以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："/**\n * 稳定 ID 序列库。\n *\n * 核心语义：\n * - 每个元素拥有稳定 ID（槽位号）+ 代际（generation）组成的句柄。\n * - 删除是逻辑删除（墓碑）：只要仍有游标保留该记录，记录就留在链表中，\n *   保证“删除当前项后 next() 到达原后继”。\n * - 游标位置 = 锚点记录之后。插入到锚点之前（含锚点处）不会被重访；\n *   插入到锚点之后会被后续 next() 访问。\n * - 墓碑在保留计数归零时被摘除并回收槽位；槽位再用时代际 +1，\n *   旧代际句柄一律失效。\n * - 游标 close() 释放其保留的记录，可能触发延迟的回收。\n * - 所有结构变化都会追加到事件日志，可与墓碑链表模型逐条核验。\n */\nexport class SequenceStore {\n    slots = [];\n    nextGens = [];\n    freeList = [];\n    headSlot = null;\n    tailSlot = null;\n    liveCount = 0;\n    eventSeq = 0;\n    cursorSeq = 0;\n    events = [];\n    get size() {\n        return this.liveCount;\n    }\n    emit(event) {\n        this.events.push({ seq: this.eventSeq++, ...event });\n    }\n    resolve(handle) {\n        const slot = this.slots[handle.id];\n        if (!slot || slot.gen !== handle.gen || slot.deleted) {\n            throw new RangeError(`stale handle: id=${handle.id} gen=${handle.gen}`);\n        }\n        return slot;\n    }\n    /** 句柄是否指向一个存活元素 */\n    has(handle) {\n        const slot = this.slots[handle.id];\n        return !!slot && slot.gen === handle.gen && !slot.deleted;\n    }\n    /** 读取存活元素的值；句柄失效返回 undefined */\n    get(handle) {\n        const slot = this.slots[handle.id];\n        if (!slot || slot.gen !== handle.gen || slot.deleted)\n            return undefined;\n        return slot.value;\n    }\n    allocate(value) {\n        let id;\n        if (this.freeList.length > 0) {\n            id = this.freeList.pop();\n        }\n        else {\n            id = this.slots.length;\n            this.slots.push(null);\n            this.nextGens.push(1);\n        }\n        const slot = {\n            id,\n            gen: this.nextGens[id],\n            value,\n            prev: null,\n            next: null,\n            deleted: false,\n            retained: 0,\n        };\n        this.slots[id] = slot;\n        return slot;\n    }\n    linkBetween(slot, prev, next) {\n        slot.prev = prev;\n        slot.next = next;\n        if (prev)\n            prev.next = slot;\n        else\n            this.headSlot = slot;\n        if (next)\n            next.prev = slot;\n        else\n            this.tailSlot = slot;\n        this.liveCount++;\n        this.emit({ type: \"insert\", id: slot.id, gen: slot.gen });\n    }\n    /** 在序列末尾插入，返回新句柄 */\n    append(value) {\n        const slot = this.allocate(value);\n        this.linkBetween(slot, this.tailSlot, null);\n        return { id: slot.id, gen: slot.gen };\n    }\n    /** 在序列开头插入，返回新句柄 */\n    prepend(value) {\n        const slot = this.allocate(value);\n        this.linkBetween(slot, null, this.headSlot);\n        return { id: slot.id, gen: slot.gen };\n    }\n    /** 在 at 之后插入；at 失效则抛错 */\n    insertAfter(at, value) {\n        const anchor = this.resolve(at);\n        const slot = this.allocate(value);\n        this.linkBetween(slot, anchor, anchor.next);\n        return { id: slot.id, gen: slot.gen };\n    }\n    /** 在 at 之前插入；at 失效则抛错 */\n    insertBefore(at, value) {\n        const anchor = this.resolve(at);\n        const slot = this.allocate(value);\n        this.linkBetween(slot, anchor.prev, anchor);\n        return { id: slot.id, gen: slot.gen };\n    }\n    /** 逻辑删除；句柄失效或重复删除抛错 */\n    delete(handle) {\n        const slot = this.resolve(handle);\n        slot.deleted = true;\n        this.liveCount--;\n        this.emit({ type: \"delete\", id: slot.id, gen: slot.gen });\n        if (slot.retained === 0)\n            this.recycle(slot);\n    }\n    /** 摘除墓碑并回收槽位；再用时 gen+1 */\n    recycle(slot) {\n        if (slot.prev)\n            slot.prev.next = slot.next;\n        else\n            this.headSlot = slot.next;\n        if (slot.next)\n            slot.next.prev = slot.prev;\n        else\n            this.tailSlot = slot.prev;\n        slot.prev = null;\n        slot.next = null;\n        this.slots[slot.id] = null;\n        this.nextGens[slot.id] = slot.gen + 1;\n        this.freeList.push(slot.id);\n        this.emit({ type: \"recycle\", id: slot.id, gen: slot.gen });\n    }\n    /** 当前可见（未删除）元素值，按序列顺序 */\n    values() {\n        const out = [];\n        for (let s = this.headSlot; s; s = s.next) {\n            if (!s.deleted)\n                out.push(s.value);\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n    /**\n     * 打开游标。\n     * 不传 at：定位于序列开头之前（next() 返回首个存活元素）。\n     * 传入 at：定位于该记录之后（该记录可为墓碑，只要代际仍有效）。\n     */\n    openCursor(at) {\n        let anchor = null;\n        if (at !== undefined) {\n            const slot = this.slots[at.id];\n            if (!slot || slot.gen !== at.gen) {\n                throw new RangeError(`stale handle: id=${at.id} gen=${at.gen}`);\n            }\n            anchor = slot;\n        }\n        const cursor = new Cursor(this, this.cursorSeq, anchor);\n        this.emit({ type: \"cursor-open\", cursor: this.cursorSeq });\n        this.cursorSeq++;\n        return cursor;\n    }\n    /** @internal 游标保留记录，阻止墓碑被回收 */\n    _retain(slot) {\n        slot.retained++;\n    }\n    /** @internal 释放保留；墓碑计数归零时回收 */\n    _release(slot) {\n        slot.retained--;\n        if (slot.deleted && slot.retained === 0)\n            this.recycle(slot);\n    }\n    /** @internal */\n    _first() {\n        return this.headSlot;\n    }\n    /** @internal */\n    _emitCursorClose(cursorId) {\n        this.emit({ type: \"cursor-close\", cursor: cursorId });\n    }\n}\nexport class Cursor {\n    store;\n    cursorId;\n    anchor;\n    closed = false;\n    constructor(store, cursorId, anchor) {\n        this.store = store;\n        this.cursorId = cursorId;\n        this.anchor = anchor;\n        if (anchor)\n            this.store._retain(anchor);\n    }\n    /**\n     * 前进到下一个存活元素并返回其句柄与值；到达末尾返回 null。\n     * 锚点（含已删除的当前项）被保留，因此删除当前项后仍能到达原后继。\n     */\n    next() {\n        if (this.closed)\n            throw new Error(\"cursor is closed\");\n        let slot = this.anchor ? this.anchor.next : this.store._first();\n        while (slot && slot.deleted)\n            slot = slot.next;\n        if (this.anchor)\n            this.store._release(this.anchor);\n        this.anchor = slot;\n        if (!slot)\n            return null;\n        this.store._retain(slot);\n        return { handle: { id: slot.id, gen: slot.gen }, value: slot.value };\n    }\n    /** 关闭游标，释放保留的记录（可能触发墓碑回收） */\n    close() {\n        if (this.closed)\n            return;\n        this.closed = true;\n        if (this.anchor) {\n            this.store._release(this.anchor);\n            this.anchor = null;\n        }\n        this.store._emitCursorClose(this.cursorId);\n    }\n}\n//# 游标锚定“当前记录”，删除当前项后 next 仍到达原后继；\n * - 插入到锚点之前不重访，插入到锚点之后可访问；\n * - 槽位复用必须提升代际；\n * - 游标关闭释放保留记录，可能触发延迟回收；\n * - 事件流（insert/delete/recycle/cursor-open/cursor-close）与实现逐条比对。\n */\nconst NIL = -1;\nexport class ModelSequence {\n    nodes = [];\n    nextGens = [];\n    freeList = [];\n    head = NIL;\n    tail = NIL;\n    cursorSeq = 0;\n    events = [];\n    alloc(value) {\n        let id;\n        if (this.freeList.length > 0) {\n            id = this.freeList.pop();\n        }\n        else {\n            id = this.nodes.length;\n            this.nodes.push(null);\n            this.nextGens.push(1);\n        }\n        this.nodes[id] = {\n            gen: this.nextGens[id],\n            value,\n            prev: NIL,\n            next: NIL,\n            deleted: false,\n            retained: 0,\n            inList: true,\n        };\n        return id;\n    }\n    link(id, prev, next) {\n        const n = this.nodes[id];\n        n.prev = prev;\n        n.next = next;\n        if (prev !== NIL)\n            this.nodes[prev].next = id;\n        else\n            this.head = id;\n        if (next !== NIL)\n            this.nodes[next].prev = id;\n        else\n            this.tail = id;\n        this.events.push({ type: \"insert\", id, gen: n.gen });\n    }\n    live(id, gen) {\n        const n = this.nodes[id];\n        if (!n || n.gen !== gen || n.deleted) {\n            throw new RangeError(`stale handle: id=${id} gen=${gen}`);\n        }\n        return n;\n    }\n    append(value) {\n        const id = this.alloc(value);\n        this.link(id, this.tail, NIL);\n        return { id, gen: this.nodes[id].gen };\n    }\n    prepend(value) {\n        const id = this.alloc(value);\n        this.link(id, NIL, this.head);\n        return { id, gen: this.nodes[id].gen };\n    }\n    insertAfter(at, value) {\n        const anchor = this.live(at.id, at.gen);\n        const id = this.alloc(value);\n        this.link(id, at.id, anchor.next);\n        return { id, gen: this.nodes[id].gen };\n    }\n    insertBefore(at, value) {\n        const anchor = this.live(at.id, at.gen);\n        const id = this.alloc(value);\n        this.link(id, anchor.prev, at.id);\n        return { id, gen: this.nodes[id].gen };\n    }\n    delete(h) {\n        const n = this.live(h.id, h.gen);\n        n.deleted = true;\n        this.events.push({ type: \"delete\", id: h.id, gen: h.gen });\n        if (n.retained === 0)\n            this.recycle(h.id);\n    }\n    recycle(id) {\n        const n = this.nodes[id];\n        if (n.prev !== NIL)\n            this.nodes[n.prev].next = n.next;\n        else\n            this.head = n.next;\n        if (n.next !== NIL)\n            this.nodes[n.next].prev = n.prev;\n        else\n            this.tail = n.prev;\n        n.prev = NIL;\n        n.next = NIL;\n        n.inList = false;\n        this.nodes[id] = null;\n        this.nextGens[id] = n.gen + 1;\n        this.freeList.push(id);\n        this.events.push({ type: \"recycle\", id, gen: n.gen });\n    }\n    values() {\n        const out = [];\n        for (let i = this.head; i !== NIL; i = this.nodes[i].next) {\n            const n = this.nodes[i];\n            if (!n.deleted)\n                out.push(n.value);\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n    openCursor(at) {\n        let anchor = NIL;\n        if (at !== undefined) {\n            const n = this.nodes[at.id];\n            if (!n || n.gen !== at.gen) {\n                throw new RangeError(`stale handle: id=${at.id} gen=${at.gen}`);\n            }\n            anchor = at.id;\n        }\n        const c = new ModelCursor(this, this.cursorSeq, anchor);\n        this.events.push({ type: \"cursor-open\", cursor: this.cursorSeq });\n        this.cursorSeq++;\n        return c;\n    }\n    _retain(id) {\n        this.nodes[id].retained++;\n    }\n    _release(id) {\n        const n = this.nodes[id];\n        n.retained--;\n        if (n.deleted && n.retained === 0)\n            this.recycle(id);\n    }\n    _first() {\n        return this.head;\n    }\n    _node(id) {\n        return this.nodes[id];\n    }\n    _emitClose(cursorId) {\n        this.events.push({ type: \"cursor-close\", cursor: cursorId });\n    }\n}\nexport class ModelCursor {\n    model;\n    cursorId;\n    anchor;\n    closed = false;\n    constructor(model, cursorId, anchor) {\n        this.model = model;\n        this.cursorId = cursorId;\n        this.anchor = anchor;\n        if (anchor !== NIL)\n            this.model._retain(anchor);\n    }\n    next() {\n if (this.closed)\n            return;\n        this.closed = true;\n        if (this.anchor !== NIL) {\n            this.model._release(this.anchor);\n            this.anchor = NIL;\n        }\n \"../src/sequence.js\";\nimport { ModelSequence } from \"./model.js\";\n/** 去掉 seq 序号后比较事件序列 */\nfunction stripSeq(events) {\n    return events.map(({ seq: _seq, ...rest }) => rest);\n}\ntest(\"删除当前项后 next 到达原后继\", () => {\n    const s = new SequenceStore();\n    s.append(\"a\");\n    s.append(\"b\");\n    s.append(\"c\");\n    const cur = s.openCursor();\n    const first = cur.next();\n    assert.equal(first.value, \"a\");\n    // 删除当前项 a，游标仍应能到达原后继 b\n    s.delete(first.handle);\n    assert.equal(cur.next().value, \"b\");\n    assert.equal(cur.next().value, \"c\");\n    assert.equal(cur.next(), null);\n    cur.close();\n    assert.deepEqual(s.values(), [\"b\", \"c\"]);\n});\ntest(\"后继也被删除时跳过墓碑到达下一个存活元素\", () => {\n    const s = new SequenceStore();\n    const hs = [1, 2, 3, 4].map((v) => s.append(v));\n    const cur = s.openCursor();\n    const first = cur.next();\n    // 删除当前项与其后的两个元素（b、c 成为墓碑）\n    s.delete(first.handle);\n    s.delete(hs[1]);\n    s.delete(hs[2]);\n    assert.equal(cur.next().value, 4);\n    assert.equal(cur.next(), null);\n    cur.close();\n});\ntest(\"插入游标之前不重访，插入游标之后可访问\", () => {\n    // 插入到锚点（游标当前位置）之后 → 可访问\n    const s = new SequenceStore();\n    const ha = s.append(\"a\");\n    const hb = s.append(\"b\");\n    s.append(\"c\");\n    const cur = s.openCursor();\n    assert.equal(cur.next().value, \"a\"); // 锚点 = a\n    s.insertAfter(ha, \"after-a\"); // 紧邻锚点之后 → 可见\n    s.insertBefore(hb, \"before-b\"); // 位于 a 与 b 之间，仍在锚点之后 → 可见\n    const seen = [];\n    for (let r = cur.next(); r; r = cur.next())\n        seen.push(r.value);\n    cur.close();\n    assert.deepEqual(seen, [\"after-a\", \"before-b\", \"b\", \"c\"]);\n    // 插入到锚点之前 → 不重访\n    const s2 = new SequenceStore();\n    const hx = s2.append(\"x\");\n    s2.append(\"y\");\n    const c2 = s2.openCursor();\n    assert.equal(c2.next().value, \"x\"); // 锚点 = x\n    s2.insertBefore(hx, \"pre-x\"); // 插到锚点之前 → 不重访\n    const seen2 = [];\n    for (let r = c2.next(); r; r = c2.next())\n        seen2.push(r.value);\n    c2.close();\n    assert.deepEqual(seen2, [\"y\"]);\n    assert.deepEqual(s2.values(), [\"pre-x\", \"x\", \"y\"]);\n});\ntest(\"ID 复用必须提升代际，旧代际句柄全部失效\", () => {\n    const s = new SequenceStore();\n    const h1 = s.append(\"v1\"); // id=0 gen=1\n    s.delete(h1); // 无游标保留 → 立即回收\n    const h2 = s.append(\"v2\"); // 复用 id=0，gen=2\n    assert.equal(h2.id, h1.id);\n    assert.equal(h2.gen, h1.gen + 1);\n    // 旧句柄失效\n    assert.equal(s.get(h1), undefined);\n    assert.equal(s.has(h1), false);\n    assert.throws(() => s.delete(h1), /stale handle/);\n    assert.throws(() => s.insertAfter(h1, \"x\"), /stale handle/);\n    assert.throws(() => s.insertBefore(h1, \"x\"), /stale handle/);\n    assert.throws(() => s.openCursor(h1), /stale handle/);\n    assert.equal(s.get(h2), \"v2\");\n});\ntest(\"游标保留墓碑，关闭后释放并触发回收\", () => {\n    const s = new SequenceStore();\n    s.append(\"a\");\n    s.append(\"b\");\n    const cur = s.openCursor(); // cursor 0\n    const first = cur.next(); // 锚点 = a，游标保留 a\n    s.delete(first.handle); // a 成墓碑但被游标保留 → 不回收\n    assert.deepEqual(stripSeq(s.events).filter((e) => e.type === \"recycle\"), []);\n    // 墓碑仍支撑遍历：next 到达原后继 b；离开 a 后保留归零 → 回收 a\n    const second = cur.next();\n    assert.equal(second.value, \"b\");\n    assert.deepEqual(stripSeq(s.events).filter((e) => e.type === \"recycle\"), [\n        { type: \"recycle\", id: first.handle.id, gen: first.handle.gen },\n    ]);\n    // 删除当前锚点 b：被游标保留 → 不回收；关闭游标时才回收\n    s.delete(second.handle);\n    const before = stripSeq(s.events).length;\n    cur.close();\n    assert.deepEqual(stripSeq(s.events).slice(before), [\n        { type: \"recycle\", id: second.handle.id, gen: second.handle.gen },\n        { type: \"cursor-close\", cursor: 0 },\n    ]);\n});\ntest(\"事件序列与墓碑链表模型核验（脚本化场景）\", () => {\n    const s = new SequenceStore();\n    const m = new ModelSequence();\n    const h1s = s.append(10);\n    const h1m = m.append(10);\n    const h2s = s.append(20);\n    const h2m = m.append(20);\n    s.prepend(5);\n    m.prepend(5);\n    const cs = s.openCursor();\n    const cm = m.openCursor();\n    assert.deepEqual(cs.next(), { handle: cm.next().handle, value: 5 });\n    s.delete(h1s); // 删除 10\n    m.delete(h1m);\n    s.insertAfter(h2s, 25); // 在 20 后插入 25\n    m.insertAfter(h2m, 25);\n    const r1s = cs.next();\n    const r1m = cm.next();\n    assert.deepEqual(r1s, r1m ? { handle: r1m.handle, value: r1m.value } : null);\n    cs.close();\n    cm.close();\n    s.delete(h2s);\n    m.delete(h2m);\n    assert.deepEqual(s.values(), m.values());\n    assert.deepEqual(stripSeq(s.events), m.events);\n});\ntest(\"随机操作序列：实现与模型的事件流、遍历结果完全一致\", () => {\n    // 确定性 PRNG（mulberry32）\n    let seed = 0x9e3779b9;\n    const rand = () => {\n        seed |= 0;\n        seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;\n        let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);\n        t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;\n        return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;\n    };\n    const pick = (arr) => arr[Math.floor(rand() * arr.length)];\n    for (let trial = 0; trial < 20; trial++) {\n        const s = new SequenceStore();\n        const m = new ModelSequence();\n        const liveS = [];\n        const liveM = [];\n        const cursS = [];\n        const cursM = [];\n        for (let step = 0; step < 400; step++) {\n            const op = Math.floor(rand() * 8);\n            if (op <= 1 || liveS.length === 0) {\n                // append / prepend\n                const v = trial * 10000 + step;\n                if (rand() < 0.5) {\n                    liveS.push(s.append(v));\n                    liveM.push(m.append(v));\n                }\n                else {\n                    liveS.push(s.prepend(v));\n                    liveM.push(m.prepend(v));\n                }\n            }\n            else if (op === 2) {\n                // delete 随机存活元素\n                const i = Math.floor(rand() * liveS.length);\n                s.delete(liveS[i]);\n                m.delete(liveM[i]);\n                liveS.splice(i, 1);\n                liveM.splice(i, 1);\n            }\n            else if (op === 3) {\n                // insertAfter / insertBefore 随机存活元素\n                const i = Math.floor(rand() * liveS.length);\n                const v = trial * 10000 + step;\n                if (rand() < 0.5) {\n                    liveS.push(s.insertAfter(liveS[i], v));\n                    liveM.push(m.insertAfter(liveM[i], v));\n                }\n                else {\n                    liveS.push(s.insertBefore(liveS[i], v));\n                    liveM.push(m.insertBefore(liveM[i], v));\n                }\n            }\n            else if (op === 4) {\n                // 打开游标（从头或从随机存活元素之后）\n                if (rand() < 0.5) {\n                    cursS.push(s.openCursor());\n                    cursM.push(m.openCursor());\n                }\n                else {\n                    const i = Math.floor(rand() * liveS.length);\n                    cursS.push(s.openCursor(liveS[i]));\n                    cursM.push(m.openCursor(liveM[i]));\n                }\n            }\n            else if (op === 5 && cursS.length > 0) {\n                // 游标 next：结果必须一致\n                const i = Math.floor(rand() * cursS.length);\n                const rs = cursS[i].next();\n                const rm = cursM[i].next();\n                assert.deepEqual(rs, rm ? { handle: rm.handle, value: rm.value } : null, `trial=${trial} step=${step} cursor next`);\n            }\n            else if (op === 6 && cursS.length > 0) {\n                // 关闭游标\n                const i = Math.floor(rand() * cursS.length);\n                cursS[i].close();\n                cursM[i].close();\n                cursS.splice(i, 1);\n                cursM.splice(i, 1);\n            }\n            else if (op === 7) {\n                // 旧句柄（可能已失效）读取：结果必须一致\n                const i = Math.floor(rand() * (liveS.length + 1));\n                if (i < liveS.length) {\n                    const gotS = s.get(liveS[i]);\n                    assert.equal(gotS !== undefined, true);\n                    void gotS;\n                }\n            }\n            // 每一步：可见序列与完整事件流必须一致\n            assert.deepEqual(s.values(), m.values(), `trial=${trial} step=${step} values`);\n            assert.deepEqual(stripSeq(s.events), m.events, `trial=${trial} step=${step} events`);\n        }\n        for (const c of cursS)\n            c.close();\n        for (const c of cursM)\n            c.close();\n        assert.deepEqual(stripSeq(s.events), m.events, `trial=${trial} final events`);\n    }\n});\ntest(\"句柄代际在游标遍历期间保持稳定\", () => {\n    const s = new SequenceStore();\n    const seen = [];\n    for (const v of [\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"])\n        seen.push(s.append(v));\n    const cur = s.openCursor();\n    const first = cur.next();\n    s.delete(first.handle);\n    s.delete(seen[1]);\n    // 触发复用：新元素可能复用已回收槽位，但 gen 不同\n    s.append(\"d\");\n    const rest = [];\n    for (let r = cur.next(); r; r = cur.next())\n        rest.push(r.value);\n    cur.close();\n    // 游标锚定链不受复用影响：只看到遍历方向上的存活元素\n    assert.deepEqual(rest, [\"c\", \"d\"]);\n});\n//# sourceMappingURL=sequence.test.js.map"

Omit<T, K>\n  : never;\n\nexport type SeqEvent =\n  | { readonly seq: number; readonly type: \"insert\"; readonly id: number; readonly gen: number }\n  | { readonly seq: number; readonly type: \"cursor-open\"; readonly cursor: number }\n  | { readonly seq: number; readonly type: \"cursor-close\"; readonly cursor: number };\n\ninterface Slot<T> {\n  readonly id: number;\n  gen: number;\n  value: T;\n  prev: Slot<T> | null;\n  next: Slot<T> | null;\n  deleted: boolean;\n  retained: number;\n}\n\nexport class SequenceStore<T> {\n  private slots: Array<Slot<T> | null> = [];\n  private nextGens: number[] = [];\n  private freeList: number[] = [];\n  private headSlot: Slot<T> | null = null;\n  private tailSlot: Slot<T> | null = null;\n  private liveCount = 0;\n  private eventSeq = 0;\n  private cursorSeq = 0;\n  readonly events: SeqEvent[] = [];\n\n  get size(): number {\n    return this.liveCount;\n  }\n\n  private emit(event: DistributiveOmit<SeqEvent, \"seq\">): void {\n    this.events.push({ seq: this.eventSeq++, ...event } as SeqEvent);\n  }\n\n  private resolve(handle: Handle): Slot<T> {\n    const slot = this.slots[handle.id];\n    if (!slot || slot.gen !== undefined {\n    const slot = this.slots[handle.id];\n    if (!slot || slot.gen !== handle.gen || slot.deleted) return undefined;\n    return slot.value;\n  }\n\n  private allocate(value: T): Slot<T> (this.anchor) this.store._release(this.anchor);\n    this.anchor = slot;\n    if (!slot) return null;\n    this.store._retain(slot);\n    return { handle: { id: slot.id, gen: slot.gen }, value: 游标锚定“当前记录”，删除当前项后 next 仍到达原后继；\n * - 插入到锚点之前不重访，插入到锚点之后可访问；\n * - 槽位复用必须提升代际；\n * - 游标关闭释放保留记录，可能触发延迟回收；\n * - 事件流（insert/delete/recycle/cursor-open/cursor-close）与实现逐条比对。\n */\n\nexport interface ModelHandle {\n  id: number;\n  gen: number;\n}\n\nexport type ModelEvent =\n  | { type: \"insert\"; id: number; gen: number }\n  | { type: \"delete\"; id: number; gen: number }\n  | { type: \"recycle\"; id: number; gen: number }\n  | { type: \"cursor-open\"; cursor: number }\n  | { type: \"cursor-close\"; cursor: number };\n\ninterface Node {\n  gen: number;\n  value: unknown;\n  prev: number;\n  next: number;\n  deleted: boolean;\n  retained: number;\n  inList: boolean;\n}\n\nconst NIL = -1;\n\nexport class ModelSequence {\n  private nodes: (Node | null)[] = [];\n  private nextGens: number[] = [];\n  private freeList: number[] = [];\n  private head = NIL;\n  private tail = NIL;\n  private cursorSeq = 0;\n  readonly events: ModelEvent[] = [];\n\n  private alloc(value: unknown): number {\n    let id: number;\n    if (this.freeList.length > 0) {\n      id = this.freeList.pop()!;\n    } else {\n      id = this.nodes.length;\n      this.nodes.push(null);\n      this.nextGens.push(1);\n    }\n    this.nodes[id] = {\n      gen: this.nextGens[id]!,\n      value,\n      prev: NIL,\n      next: NIL,\n      deleted: false,\n      retained: 0,\n      inList: true,\n    };\n    return id;\n  }\n\n  private link(id: number, prev: number, next: number): void {\n    const n = this.nodes[id]!;\n    n.prev = prev;\n    n.next = next;\n    if (prev !== NIL) this.nodes[prev]!.next = id;\n    else this.head = id;\n    if (next !== NIL) this.nodes[next]!.prev = id;\n    else this.tail = id;\n    this.events.push({ type: \"insert\", id, gen: n.gen });\n  }\n\n  private live(id: number, gen: number): Node {\n    const n = this.nodes[id];\n    if (!n || n.gen !== gen || n.deleted) {\n      throw new RangeError(`stale handle: id=${id} gen=${gen}`);\n    }\n    return n;\n  }\n\n  append(value: unknown): ModelHandle {\n    const id = this.alloc(value);\n    this.link(id, this.tail, NIL);\n    return { id, gen: this.nodes[id]!.gen };\n  }\n\n  prepend(value: unknown): ModelHandle {\n    const id = this.alloc(value);\n    this.link(id, NIL, this.head);\n    return { id, gen: this.nodes[id]!.gen };\n  }\n\n  insertAfter(at: ModelHandle, value: unknown): ModelHandle {\n    const anchor = this.live(at.id, at.gen);\n    const id = this.alloc(value);\n    this.link(id, at.id, anchor.next);\n    return { id, gen: this.nodes[id]!.gen };\n  }\n\n  insertBefore(at: ModelHandle, value: unknown): ModelHandle {\n    const anchor = this.live(at.id, at.gen);\n    const id = this.alloc(value);\n    this.link(id, anchor.prev, at.id);\n    return { id, gen: this.nodes[id]!.gen };\n  }\n\n  delete(h: ModelHandle): void {\n    const n = this.live(h.id, h.gen);\n    n.deleted = true;\n    this.events.push({ type: \"delete\", id: h.id, gen: h.gen });\n    if (n.retained === 0) this.recycle(h.id);\n  }\n\n  private recycle(id: number): void {\n    const n = this.nodes[id]!;\n    if (n.prev !== NIL) this.nodes[n.prev]!.next = n.next;\n    else this.head = n.next;\n    if (n.next !== NIL) this.nodes[n.next]!.prev = n.prev;\n    else this.tail = n.prev;\n    n.prev = NIL;\n    n.next = NIL;\n    n.inList = false;\n    this.nodes[id] = null;\n    this.nextGens[id] = n.gen + 1;\n    this.freeList.push(id);\n    this.events.push({ type: \"recycle\", id, gen: n.gen });\n  }\n\n  values(): unknown[] {\n    const out: unknown[] = [];\n    for (let i = this.head; i !== NIL; i = this.nodes[i]!.next) {\n      const n = this.nodes[i]!;\n      if (!n.deleted) out.push(n.value);\n    }\n    return out;\n  }\n\n  openCursor(at?: ModelHandle): ModelCursor {\n    let anchor = NIL;\n    if (at !== undefined) {\n      const n = this.nodes[at.id];\n      if (!n || n.gen !== at.gen) {\n        throw new RangeError(`stale handle: id=${at.id} gen=${at.gen}`);\n      }\n      anchor = at.id;\n    }\n    const c = new ModelCursor(this, this.cursorSeq, anchor);\n    this.events.push({ type: \"cursor-open\", cursor: this.cursorSeq });\n    this.cursorSeq++;\n    return c;\n  }\n\n  _retain(id: number): void {\n    this.nodes[id]!.retained++;\n  }\n\n  _release(id: number): void {\n    const n = this.nodes[id]!;\n    n.retained--;\n    if (n.deleted && n.retained === 0) this.recycle(id);\n  }\n\n  _first(): number {\n    return this.head;\n  }\n\n  _node(id: number): Node {\n    return this.nodes[id]!;\n  }\n\n  _emitClose(cursorId: number): void {\n    this.events.push({ type: \"cursor-close\", cursor: cursorId });\n  }\n}\n\nexport class ModelCursor {\n  private closed = false;\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly model: ModelSequence,\n    readonly cursorId: number,\n    private anchor: number,\n  ) {\n    if (anchor !== NIL) this.model._retain(anchor);\n  }\n\n  next(): { handle: ModelHandle; value: unknown } | null {\n    if (this.closed) throw new Error(\"cursor is closed\");\n    let i = this.anchor === NIL ? this.model._first() : this.model._node(this.anchor).next;\n    while (i !== NIL && this.model._node(i).deleted) i = this.model._node(i).next;\n    if (this.anchor !== NIL) this.model._release(this.anchor);\n    this.anchor = i;\n    if (i === NIL) return null;\n    this.model._retain(i);\n    const n = this.model._node(i);\n    return { handle: { id: i, gen: n.gen }, value: n.value };\n  }\n\n  close(): void {\n    if (this.closed) return;\n    this.closed = true;\n    if (this.anchor !== NIL) {\n      this.model._release(this.anchor);\n      this.anchor = NIL;\n    }\n    this.model._emitClose(this.cursorId);\n  }\n}\n"

// 确定性 PRNG（mulberry32）\n  let seed = 0x9e3779b9;\n  const rand = () => {\n    seed |= 0;\n    seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;\n    let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);\n    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;\n    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;\n  };\n  const pick = <T>(arr: T[]): T => arr[Math.floor(rand() * arr.length)]!;\n\n  for (let trial = 0; trial < 20; trial++) {\n    const s = new SequenceStore<number>();\n    const m = new ModelSequence();\n    const liveS: Handle[] = [];\n    const liveM: { id: number; gen: number }[] = [];\n    const cursS: ReturnType<SequenceStore<number>[\"openCursor\"]>[] = [];\n    const cursM: ReturnType<ModelSequence[\"openCursor\"]>[] = [];\n\n    for (let step = 0; step < 400; step++) {\n      const op = Math.floor(rand() * 8);\n      if (op <= 1 || liveS.length === 0) {\n        // append / prepend\n        const v = trial * 10000 + step;\n        if (rand() < 0.5) {\n          liveS.push(s.append(v));\n          liveM.push(m.append(v));\n        } else {\n          liveS.push(s.prepend(v));\n          liveM.push(m.prepend(v));\n        }\n      } else if (op === 2) {\n        // delete 随机存活元素\n        const i = Math.floor(rand() * liveS.length);\n        s.delete(liveS[i]!);\n        m.delete(liveM[i]!);\n        liveS.splice(i, 1);\n        liveM.splice(i, 1);\n      } else if (op === 3) {\n        // insertAfter / insertBefore 随机存活元素\n        const i = Math.floor(rand() * liveS.length);\n        const v = trial * 10000 + step;\n        if (rand() < 0.5) {\n liveM.push(m.insertBefore(liveM[i]!, v));\n        }\n      } else if (op === 4) {\n        // 打开游标（从头或从随机存活元素之后）\n        if (rand() < 0.5) {\n          cursS.push(s.openCursor());\n          cursM.push(m.openCursor());\n        } else {\n          const i = Math.floor(rand() * liveS.length);\n          cursS.push(s.openCursor(liveS[i]!));\n          cursM.push(m.openCursor(liveM[i]!));\n        }\n      } else if (op === 5 && cursS.length > 0) {\n        // 游标 next：结果必须一致\n        const i = Math.floor(rand() * cursS.length);\n        const rs = cursS[i]!.next();\n        const rm = cursS) c.close();\n    for (const c of cursM) c.close();\n    assert.deepEqual(stripSeq(s.events), m.events, `trial=${trial} final events`);\n  }\n});\n\ntest(\"句柄代际在游标遍历期间保持稳定\", () => {\n  const s = new SequenceStore<string>();\n  const seen: Handle[] = [];\n  for (const v of [\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"]) seen.push(s.append(v));\n  const cur = s.openCursor();\n  const first = cur.next()!;\n
